description: Create complete AWS deployment infrastructure: all scripts, configs, and documentation needed to deploy the Creatools app to EC2 + RDS PostgreSQL with Nginx + SSL for 3 domains. This includes AWS provisioning instructions, server setup script, Nginx config, PM2 ecosystem config, deploy script, env example, and DNS/security group documentation.
steps: Create deploy/ directory at project root with all deployment files
Create deploy/README.md with complete step-by-step deployment guide covering: AWS provisioning (EC2 c6i.large + RDS db.t3.small), security groups, DNS configuration for all 3 domains

Create deploy/aws-provision.sh - AWS CLI script to provision EC2 c6i.large instance and RDS PostgreSQL db.t3.small, configure security groups (SSH 22, HTTP 80, HTTPS 443 inbound on EC2; PostgreSQL 5432 from EC2 SG only on RDS), create key pair, allocate Elastic IP

Create deploy/server-setup.sh - Script to run on EC2 to install Node.js 20 LTS, pnpm, PM2, Nginx, Certbot with all dependencies. Also configure firewall (ufw) and create app directory structure at /opt/creatools

Create deploy/nginx/creatools.conf - Nginx server blocks for all 3 domains (creatools.co, creatools.stream, creatools.live) with: SSL via Let's Encrypt (certbot), HTTP to HTTPS redirect, reverse proxy to localhost:8080 for /api, serve static frontend files from /opt/creatools/frontend for all other paths, SPA fallback (try_files), gzip compression, security headers, websocket support if needed

Create deploy/nginx/ssl-setup.sh - Script to obtain SSL certificates using certbot for all 3 domains (certbot --nginx -d creatools.co -d www.creatools.co -d creatools.stream -d www.creatools.stream -d creatools.live -d www.creatools.live), set up auto-renewal cron

Create deploy/ecosystem.config.cjs - PM2 ecosystem config for the API server in cluster mode (using max available CPUs on c6i.large = 2), with proper env vars (PORT=8080, NODE_ENV=production, DATABASE_URL from env), log rotation settings, restart policy

Create deploy/deploy.sh - Automated deploy script that: pulls latest code from git, installs dependencies (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile), builds API (pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build), builds frontend (PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/creatools build), copies frontend dist to Nginx serve dir (/opt/creatools/frontend), restarts PM2 processes, runs schema push if DATABASE_URL available

Create deploy/.env.example - Example env file with all required variables: DATABASE_URL (postgres://user:pass@rds-endpoint:5432/creatools), PORT=8080, NODE_ENV=production, JWT_SECRET, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, TIKTOOLS_API_KEY, GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE creds (GCS_PROJECT_ID, GCS_BUCKET_NAME, GCS_KEY_FILE_PATH or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS)

Create deploy/dns-setup.md - Documentation for DNS A records: creatools.co -> EC2 Elastic IP, creatools.stream -> EC2 Elastic IP, creatools.live -> EC2 Elastic IP, plus www subdomains as CNAME to root
Create deploy/security-groups.md - Documentation for AWS security groups with exact rules for EC2 and RDS instances
Create deploy/backup.sh - Script for automated PostgreSQL backups via pg_dump to local file + optional S3 upload, with cron setup instructions
acceptance_criteria: deploy/ directory exists with all files mentioned in steps
All shell scripts are syntactically valid (pass bash -n check)
Nginx config is syntactically valid (can be checked with nginx -t pattern)
PM2 ecosystem config is valid JavaScript that exports proper config
deploy.sh properly builds both API and frontend with correct env vars
.env.example contains all environment variables the app needs
README.md provides a complete end-to-end deployment guide
verification: Run bash -n on all .sh files in deploy/ to verify syntax
Run node -c deploy/ecosystem.config.cjs to verify JS syntax
Confirm all 3 domains are configured in Nginx conf
Confirm PM2 config uses cluster mode with 2 instances
findings: All 11 deployment files created and verified. All .sh files pass bash -n syntax check. ecosystem.config.cjs passes node -c syntax check. Node.js is available via nvm (v20.20.2) at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin/node but not on default PATH - need to source nvm.sh first.
